Guest favourites Arrival and departure transfers Private chef Car and boat rental Grocery delivery Baby-sitter Massage and spa treatments Local presence We handpick only the finest services, personally testing each one to guarantee exceptional quality and professionalism. Discover our services Remarkable experiences Our concierge team designs magical, one-of-a-kind experiences that capture the essence of your destination, always crafted according to your interests. For them, every journey is a pursuit of the extraordinary, and a search for authenticity and depth. Artists of the ephemeral, they craft rare moments; adventures you'll remember for years to come. Experiences our guests loved A private key to the Musée d'Orsay Enjoy exclusive access to the iconic museum, fully privatised for you to explore its masterpieces in complete privacy and tranquility - even during the busiest season. In the footsteps of The Godfather Step into a legendary film on an immersive adventure. Explore Mount Etna's slopes, wander Savoca's charming streets, and unlock Castello degli Schiavi, the film's storied estate. Michelin in the mountains Arrive to a secret mountaintop location where an elegant setting is carved from snow and ice. The menu? On-ice classics like champagne, oysters, and sushi followed by a traditional alpine meal. Explore our experiences 3 collections 3 levels of concierge service Each home comes with a level of concierge service tailored to its collection. All collections include dedicated support until your arrival and a personalised welcome by a local team member. Essential Collection The Essential Collection includes concierge support prior to your arrival and access to a selection of optional services, offering a unique glimpse into the made to measure holidays we create. Signature Collection The Signature Collection includes dedicated concierge support before and during your stay, as well as access to a selection of services and experiences carefully chosen by our local teams. Iconic Collection The Iconic Collection combines our most extraordinary homes with our highest level of bespoke holiday tailoring. Enjoy concierge support before and during your stay, as well as access to all our services and experiences.
